prompt:
Write the footer text that sits under the Settings switch "Check for updates automatically" in OpenRamble, a dictation app that promises your voice never leaves your Mac.

Facts: the switch is on by default, so that security fixes arrive. Once a day the app reads a small version list. The request contains the app version and the IP address. It contains no device profile and no dictated content. Turning the switch off stops all scheduled network access.

Give only the footer text.
required: The switch is on by default
The check happens once a day
The request contains the app version and the IP address
Turning it off stops scheduled network access
reference: On by default so security fixes can reach you. Once a day, the app reads a small version list. The request contains the app version and your IP address, but no device profile or dictated content. Turn this off to stop scheduled network access.
